name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: (7 a) For the purpose of consistency with this Directive, it is important that financial sector legislation remains coherent with its provisions. In this context, it should be considered whether requirements for the financial sector ought to be framed in a way that does not create an obligation for financial undertakings to obtain any information from undertakings which are not obliged to publish non-financial information pursuant to Article 19a or 29a of Directive 2013/34/EU. It should also be considered whether sector-specific financial services legislation, including delegated acts, guidelines by the ESAs and supervisory expectations, ought to be adapted to take into account the content of this Directive.
